changes.content:
networks:
    1panel-network:
        external: true
services:
    api:
        command: node dist/src/harness.js --start-docker
        container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}
        depends_on:
            - rabbitmq
        deploy:
            resources:
                limits:
                    cpus: ${CPUS}
                    memory: ${MEMORY_LIMIT}
        environment:
            - HOST=0.0.0.0
            - PORT=3002
            - ENV=local
            - REDIS_URL=redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD}@${REDIS_HOST}:${REDIS_PORT}
            - REDIS_RATE_LIMIT_URL=redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD}@${REDIS_HOST}:${REDIS_PORT}
            - PLAYWRIGHT_MICROSERVICE_URL=http://${CONTAINER_NAME}-playwright:3000/scrape
            - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}
            - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
            - POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB}
            - POSTGRES_HOST=${POSTGRES_HOST}
            - POSTGRES_PORT=${POSTGRES_PORT}
            - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@${POSTGRES_HOST}:${POSTGRES_PORT}/${POSTGRES_DB}
            - USE_DB_AUTHENTICATION=${USE_DB_AUTHENTICATION}
            - NUM_WORKERS_PER_QUEUE=${NUM_WORKERS_PER_QUEUE}
            - CRAWL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS=${CRAWL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS}
            - MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS=${MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS}
            - BROWSER_POOL_SIZE=5
            - NUQ_RABBITMQ_URL=amqp://${RABBITMQ_USER}:${RABBITMQ_PASSWORD}@${CONTAINER_NAME}-rabbitmq:5672
            - BULL_AUTH_KEY=${BULL_AUTH_KEY}
        image: ghcr.io/firecrawl/firecrawl:2.11.199
        labels:
            createdBy: Apps
        networks:
            - 1panel-network
        ports:
            - ${HOST_IP}:${PANEL_APP_PORT_API}:3002
        restart: always
        volumes:
            - ${DATA_PATH}/api-data:/app/data
    playwright-service:
        container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}-playwright
        environment:
            - PORT=3000
            - MAX_CONCURRENT_PAGES=${CRAWL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS}
        image: ghcr.io/firecrawl/playwright-service:latest
        labels:
            createdBy: Apps
        networks:
            - 1panel-network
        ports:
            - ${PANEL_APP_PORT_PLAYWRIGHT}:3000
        restart: always
        tmpfs:
            - /tmp/.cache:noexec,nosuid,size=1g
    rabbitmq:
        container_name: ${CONTAINER_NAME}-rabbitmq
        environment:
            - RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER=${RABBITMQ_USER}
            - RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS=${RABBITMQ_PASSWORD}
        healthcheck:
            interval: 5s
            retries: 3
            start_period: 5s
            test:
                - CMD
                - rabbitmq-diagnostics
                - -q
                - check_running
            timeout: 5s
        image: rabbitmq:3-management
        labels:
            createdBy: Apps
        networks:
            - 1panel-network
        ports:
            - ${PANEL_APP_PORT_RABBITMQ}:5672
            - ${PANEL_APP_PORT_RABBITMQ_MGMT}:15672
        restart: always
        volumes:
            - ${DATA_PATH}/rabbitmq:/var/lib/rabbitmq
